section.title: My work contexts
section.subtitle: Variants of your activity (market, sector, offer) that never touch your main profile.

create.title: New work context
create.description: A variant of your profile, alongside it — your main profile never changes.
create.profileUnchangedNotice: Your main profile will never be changed automatically.

mode.title: Work context
mode.intro: What {{copilot}} uses to personalise her answers in this conversation.
mode.profileUntouched: Your profile is never changed: this choice only applies to this conversation.

my_activity.label: My activity
my_activity.does: {{copilot}} relies on your profile, company, business units, memory, portfolio and CRM. Your request always comes first.
my_activity.when: Day to day, for your accounts and priorities.

one_off_mission.label: One-off mission
one_off_mission.does: {{copilot}} reasons only on your request and what you selected, without your usual sectors, territories or goals.
one_off_mission.when: For a brief outside your usual scope (another region, another sector).

neutral.label: Neutral
neutral.does: {{copilot}} uses neither your profile, your CRM, your portfolio nor your memory: only your request and public sources.
neutral.when: To explore a market without bias or compare with a personalised result.

help.one_off_mission: Set in the scope panel; switching on restores My activity.
